title: rinorea ilicifolia subsp. amplexicaulis
intro: Rinorea ilicifolia subsp. amplexicaulis, commonly known as the "Stinking Passion Flower," is a plant species belonging to the Violaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its use in treating fever, cough, and rheumatic conditions. The therapeutic actions of Rinorea ilicifolia subsp. amplexicaulis include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms associated with colds and flu. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety for human use.
